title: Indicator sum for output-pivotal coordinates
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs, let $b$ be a sign, and let $x$ be a cube point. The number of coordinates at which $f$ is pivotal at $x$ and $f(x)=b$, viewed as a real number, equals the sum over all coordinates of the indicator that these two conditions hold.
hypotheses_covered: sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
